text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I sketched a Friday send that combines the benchmark teaser + webinar invite. Need PD on segmentation and send windows. TL;DR: two lists (warm-engaged, product-trial), 1 subject A/B, and an APAC stagger. Can we move fast?
Priya: Love it. Warm-engaged = opened any email in last 60d + visited docs in 30d? That cut gave best CTR last quarter.
Marco: For routing — recommend mapping trial accounts to 'sales+webinar' tag via inbound webhook so we handoff RSVP immediately. I can add a small Zapier/automation or use `inbound.route()` in the campaign infra.
Dana: Copy thought: lead with a short benchmark stat (one sentence) then CTA for the webinar. Example subject: "How we cut gen-costs 2.3x — join our short benchmark demo".
Marta: I can draft 4 subject lines for A/B and a preheader. Also propose two send windows: Friday 10am PT for NA + stagger to Mon 10am APAC.
Alex: Nice. Priya — can you confirm the warm-engaged definition and size? Need ETA on list volumes so we can confirm deliverability.
Priya: Warm-engaged estimate: ~18k. Trial segment: ~3.2k. Will send exact export by EOD.
Marco: For automation snippet, using our campaign DSL: ```segment("warm-engaged").filter(opened_60d, visited_docs_30d).route_to(webinar_flow, tag="sales-webinar")``` Will add TTL and de-dupe.
Dana: Also suggest swapping the hero image for a benchmark chart (tiny) to increase credibility. Keeps email <120kb.
Marta: Quick A/B plan: Subject A = benchmark-led, Subject B = webinar-invite-led; Metric: registrations and CTR to landing page. Run for 24 hours then send winner to remainder.
campaign-bot: Campaign job scheduled: `newsletter/drip/benchmark-webinar` queued for 2024-11-22T17:00:00Z. Job id: cb-7732.
Alex: Outstanding. Action items: Priya export, Marco hook inbound routing + de-dupe, Marta finish subjects + preheaders, Dana finalize hero copy, I'll prep the landing RSVP variant. Check-ins tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
